title: NIST WTC investigation, phase 1 spray-burner compartment tests (NIST NCSTAR 1-5B)
reference: Hamins, A. et al. (2005). Federal building and fire safety investigation of the World Trade Center disaster: experiments and modeling of structural steel elements exposed to fire. NIST NCSTAR 1-5B, volume 1. doi:10.6028/NIST.NCSTAR.1-5Bv1
notice: Measurements from NIST's Fire Research Division Experimental Database (github.com/firemodels/exp) and test conditions from NIST's FDS validation inputs (github.com/firemodels/fds), both carrying NIST's notice: NIST-developed works, not subject to copyright protection within the United States; acknowledge the National Institute of Standards and Technology as the source; modified works should note the date and nature of any change. heldOut: never used to fit any solver parameter (fire-calibration-plan-2026-11-11.md, section 12)
